requirement_set.title: NSR-10 Titulo K (K.3 Medios de evacuacion) - example set

sources.norm: Reglamento Colombiano de Construccion Sismo Resistente NSR-10, Titulo K - Requisitos complementarios, Capitulo K.3 (text of the Comision Asesora Permanente para el Regimen de Construcciones Sismo Resistentes, Decreto 926 de 2010)
Ministerio de Vivienda, Ciudad y Territorio - Anexo tecnico de modificaciones a la NSR-10
sources.read: 2026-09-24, full text: its only change to Titulo K is the cross-reference of K.3.2.5 (alarmas); no value used here is modified

requirement_set.disclaimer: Example requirement set, not a compliance assessment. Verify the edition in force and the project's occupancy group. Exit doors, stairs requiring 1.20 m and room occupancy groups are selected through PLACEHOLDER parameters ('Exit Door', 'NSR10 Stair Class', 'Occupancy Group'): rename them to the parameters your project uses, or those rules examine nothing and stay not_decidable.

source.text: contrahuella no menor de 100 mm ni mayor de 180 mm
contrahuella no menor de 100 mm ni mayor de 180 mm
ancho minimo de huella, sin incluir proyecciones, 280 mm

rules.note: Straight flights. Curved flights (K.3.8.3.4 d: 240 mm at 1/3 from the inner edge), circular stairs (K.3.8.3.9: 250 mm) and spiral stairs (K.3.8.3.10: 190 mm at 300 mm) are measured differently and are not separated by this selector.

source.text: 2 contrahuellas + 1 huella, sin proyecciones, entre 620 mm y 640 mm
carga de ocupacion inferior a 50: ancho minimo 900 mm; superior a 50 y escaleras de uso publico: 1.20 m

rules.note: 900 mm is the floor for an evacuation stair (K.3.8.3 excludes stairs inside dwellings, where 750 mm applies). Stairs that serve more than 50 people or public use need 1 200 mm: see stair-width-public-or-over-50. If the handrail stands more than 50 mm off the wall the width grows by the excess; the measure does not deduct handrails.

source.text: escaleras con carga de ocupacion superior a 50 personas y de uso publico: ancho minimo 1.20 m

rules.note: 'NSR10 Stair Class' is a placeholder: the model does not know the occupant load a stair serves. Mark those stairs with a parameter your project uses. Capacity by Tabla K.3.3-2 (mm per person) may demand more than 1 200 mm; this set does not compute it.

source.text: luz minima efectiva de 800 mm (dormitorios 700 mm; cada abertura de una puerta subdividida >= 700 mm)

rules.note: 'Exit Door' = 'Yes' is a placeholder. The measure is the nominal leaf width, an upper bound of the clear width: below 800 it fails for certain, at or above it is not_decidable.

source.text: las puertas no deben tener menos de 2.0 m de altura (se excluyen particiones sanitarias)

rules.note: DOOR_HEIGHT is the nominal opening height (instance, then type).

Tabla K.3.3-1 gives m2 of net floor area per occupant by group. 'Occupancy Group' is a placeholder room parameter carrying the group code; C-2 has two factors (street level and below: 'C-2 calle' = 3; other floors: 'C-2 otros' = 6). E and T ('segun ocupacion') and M (the largest load of its components) have no fixed factor, so a room declaring them is not_decidable. Fixed seating counts seats instead (K.3.3.1.2 b), K.3.3.1.2 takes the larger of the real occupants and area/factor, and K.3.3.2.3 allows omitting toilets and storage: a room parameter with the load (occupant_load_parameter) expresses those cases.

The limits WERE read (Tabla K.3.6-1: 22 to 120 m by group and sprinklers, +30 % under its note; K.3.6.3: 15 m inside a room of up to 6 people; K.3.5.1.3: dead ends 6 m) and are transcribed in docs/TOOLS-EXTENDED.md, but no single number applies to every room and horizun_code_check never computes this measure: kept without a value. horizun_audit_access with route_view_id routes a real path.
